notes: Bank balances read correctly from far more SMS formats (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB, Canara, IndusInd, Federal and many more)
Your available balance is never mixed up with the minimum, ledger or monthly-average balance

Credit cards stay counted separately from your spendable balance
